h: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala's mother, Professor Kamene Okonjo, reportedly dies at 96
p: Professor Kamene Okonjo, the mother of World Trade Organization Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, has reportedly died at the age of 96. She was a respected academic and the widow of the late Professor Chukuka Okonjo, the Obi of Ogwashi-Uku. The family is yet to share funeral details publicly.
more: She and her husband were married for 66 years before his death.
Tributes are expected from across Nigeria's academic and political circles.
